 Negligence and Tort – Suit settles for policy limits following two-car crash 
 Virginia Lawyers Weekly // November 9, 2026 // 
 -->
 Listen to this article 
 $420,000 settlement 
 Injuries alleged: Multiple rib fractures, right tibial plateau fracture and dislocated right ankle
 Court: Bedford County Circuit Court 
 Amount: $420,000
 Attorney for plaintiff: John C. Shea , Henrico County, Marks & Harrison
 Case description: The plaintiff was involved in a two-vehicle crash in Bedford County when a vehicle pulled directly in front of him across the road. The plaintiff claimed that his way was blocked. 
 The defense claimed that the plaintiff was speeding and had an eyewitness to that effect. The plaintiff suffered severe neuropathy , which prevented him from essentially feeling his feet, and he was often unable to tell the difference between the gas and brake pedals.
 The case was settled for the policy limits after suit was filed but before discovery was undertaken.
